name: VeriWorld
description: VeriWorld is an executable benchmark for spatial reasoning in interactive 3D environments. This metadata describes the task catalogue and the matched evaluation records accompanying the camera-ready paper. Each record identifies its task, information condition, harness, model, seed, terminal success, and source-record hash. The separate Unreal Engine runtime and third-party scene content have their own license terms.
citeAs: @inproceedings{veriworld2026, title={{VeriWorld: A Verifiable Visual SWE-Bench for Spatial Reasoning in 3D Environments}}, author={Yan Zheng and ShengYun Peng and Xuyao Liang and Xiaoyan Cong and Nuo Chen and Bangya Liu and Zihan Wang and Wenyan Cong and Zhiwen Fan and Zhangyang Wang}, booktitle={Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems}, year={2026}}
citation: Yan Zheng; ShengYun Peng; Xuyao Liang; Xiaoyan Cong; Nuo Chen; Bangya Liu; Zihan Wang; Wenyan Cong; Zhiwen Fan; Zhangyang Wang. VeriWorld: A Verifiable Visual SWE-Bench for Spatial Reasoning in 3D Environments. NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track.
rai:dataCollection: Instances are generated from task-specific seeds and rendered in Unreal Engine 5. Some scenes use licensed third-party assets. Evaluation records contain model actions and automatic verifier outcomes. No human subjects or scraped personal data are involved.
rai:dataCollectionType: Procedural generation, synthetic rendering, and model evaluation.
rai:dataCollectionMissingData: API and runtime failures are unscored. Core comparisons use common valid V/S/C seed sets; 74 additional valid unpaired outcomes are retained separately. Partial Photoreal and computational-physics panels retain actual denominators and are excluded from complete-model aggregates.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Task code, generated parameters, rendered observations, action traces, and verifier records are separate artifacts. The tabular records here are derived from terminal episode summaries; source hashes identify the archived summaries.
rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: The matched core panels were evaluated from 2026-05-05 through 2026-11-02. Per-record run timestamps are provided.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Deduplicate copies of a run, use the latest terminal record for each task/harness/model/seed for the reported model version, and match V/S/C seed sets within each model. Explicit infrastructure crashes and records without terminal outcomes are excluded. Failed terminal runs are retained.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Generators specify the scene and task parameters. Runtime verifiers check agent outcomes. Selected tasks additionally use reachability checks, reference solutions, or simulator checks to test instance solvability.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automatic task-specific verifiers produce the success labels. Billiards uses fraction pocketed and is not included in the binary core-record table.
rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Local benchmark harnesses and deterministic verifiers.
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Task-specific thresholds are defined by the corresponding verifier. Comparisons hold the task instance, action interface, and verifier fixed.
rai:annotationsPerItem: One terminal outcome per evaluation record.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Python task verifiers; deterministic physics rollouts for computational tasks. Lean 4 is used for selected instance-solvability checks, not as the outcome judge for every task.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The public repository is https://github.com/yanyanzheng96/VeriWorld-release. Release snapshots, documentation, and metadata should be versioned together. Generator or verifier changes must identify a new evaluation configuration. The Unreal runtime is distributed separately under its applicable terms.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No human-subject data or scraped personal data. Model identifiers and public author attribution are included.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Supports reproducible diagnosis of spatial reasoning under controlled conditions. Benchmark performance is not a safety or deployment guarantee for robotics or embodied agents.
rai:dataBiases: Task families, synthetic rendering, English prompts, and selected API models define the evaluation scope. Performance need not generalize to natural sensors, other task distributions, or later API versions.
rai:dataLimitations: The catalogue covers eleven task families. The tabular core records cover four matched V/S/C panels. Other tables and harness studies are documented separately. Model API behavior can change. Synthetic evaluation does not establish real-robot performance.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluation and analysis of spatial reasoning, information conditions, and action harnesses. The metadata license follows the existing dataset declaration and does not grant rights to the separately distributed engine or third-party assets.

recordSet.name: computational_physics_episodes
recordSet.description: 185 valid terminal episodes: ten complete model panels of 18 episodes and five partial Kimi episodes. Three seeds per task. Feedback-policy variants are explicit; API outages are unscored. See SUPPORTING_DATA.txt.

recordSet.name: photoreal_episodes
recordSet.description: 946 valid scored Photoreal episodes. All retained PASS and FAIL outcomes included. Complete-model comparisons use 6 models with 140 cells each; other models remain partial. API outages are unscored. See SUPPORTING_DATA.txt.

recordSet.name: Valid core outcomes outside matched V/S/C triplets
recordSet.description: All valid core outcomes not included in matched triplets. Missing counterparts are not failures. These rows do not enter the paired core means.
